name: Planted-issue review of a vendor SaaS MSA

brief.objective: Review Northwind's MSA against Harborlight's approved playbook and produce the issue list.

notes: Planted deviations the issue list must catch: cap of 3 months of fees paid (9.2); cap applied to indemnity and confidentiality claims with no carve-outs (9.3, critical, escalate); one-way customer indemnity for any breach (8.1, critical, escalate); perpetual licence to use Customer Data to train (5.2, escalate); breach notice with no fixed window and no DPA (6.2); full as-is disclaimer (7.1); 90-day non-renewal notice (3.2); unilateral mid-term price increases and net 15 (2.1, 2.2); one-sided assignment (10.1); Delaware law (11.1, fallback-acceptable, low). Insurance and non-solicitation are absent. Section 14 cross-reference in 12.1 is dangling and should be mentioned in the review notes.
